card.what: Dinghy's metal tiller: a round anodised aluminium tube, 32 mm, a moulded anodised insert in its rudder end with the retaining pin, a textured rubber grip over the hand end, a plastic end cap (carbon=True: the same in carbon)
card.boats: Sunfish (the current factory tiller: 44 in aluminium, rigged with a 36 in extension), ILCA (990 mm, 32 mm), Hobie 16 tiller arms; carbon for racing dinghies
card.distance: arm's reach: the helm holds the extension and the tiller's end
card.before: no metal tiller in the kit: the Sunfish and ILCA bake their own in Tools/blender/build_fleet.py (sunfish_rudder_head: a varnished wooden bar on the Sunfish, a 28 mm tube with a black end on the ILCA)

references.note: Sunfish 44 in rigged aluminium tiller with 36 in extension, 'the standard size rigged tiller' (interchangeable with Sunfish part 85210; Murray's sells the same); numbers from search snippets: the cloud can't open the shop pages

ILCA standard tiller: 32 mm aluminium, silver anodised, no chafe plate, no cleat; moulded anodised aluminium insert at the rudder end, plastic cap at the hand end; textured grip; RWO set 31.5 mm x 990 mm with a 1070 mm extension
ILCA tiller retainer pin through the rudder head and the tiller's insert
